queries.text:
SELECT u.id AS author_id, u.display_name, count(p.id) AS posts
FROM app.users u
LEFT JOIN app.posts p ON p.author_id = u.id
WHERE u.tenant_id = @p1
GROUP BY u.id, u.display_name

SELECT id, tenant_id, email, display_name, created_at, updated_at, version
FROM app.users
WHERE tenant_id = @p2 AND email = @p1

UPDATE app.users
SET display_name = @p1, version = version + 1
WHERE tenant_id = @p4 AND id = @p2 AND version = @p3

SELECT TOP (@p1) id, display_name
FROM app.users
WHERE tenant_id = @p3 AND (@p2 = N'' OR display_name LIKE N'%' + @p2 + N'%')
ORDER BY id

SELECT id, email
FROM app.users
WHERE tenant_id = @p2 AND email IN (SELECT [v] FROM OPENJSON(@p1) WITH ([v] nvarchar(320) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS '$'))
ORDER BY id
